purpose: Assess whether another official MLAgentBench task can be added beyond the scored CIFAR10/debug and OGBN-arxiv official-evaluator paths.

already_scored_or_used.reason: Already scored as official CIFAR10/debug evidence with three co-pilot-selected seeds.
Already scored as an official-evaluator compatibility path with three co-pilot-selected seeds.
Already used as a correctness-gated MLAgentBench controlled program-search probe.

candidate_probed.task_type: language-model training from scratch on BabyLM data
candidate_probed.prepare_result: Downloaded the 241 MB BabyLM archive from GitHub and unpacked a 157 MB task copy with 10M train, dev, and test splits.
compatibility_repairs: Downgraded datasets to 2.19.2 because newer datasets releases reject local dataset scripts.
Used a clearly marked train_compat.py probe copy that removes deprecated transformers telemetry and TPU helper imports.
Changed the default config_name in the probe copy to allow a small from-scratch GPT-2 config override.
candidate_probed.tiny_train_command_class: small from-scratch GPT-2 compatibility run with 96 max train samples, 32 max eval samples, block_size 64, and a two-layer config
candidate_probed.blocking_error: HuggingFace network is unreachable for gpt2 tokenizer/config assets, causing AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('gpt2') to fail.

not_selected_due_to_access_or_cost.reason: Their prepare scripts prompt for Kaggle competition consent and call kaggle competitions download.
The task definitions require Anthropic/Claude API keys and ArXiv or Google Scholar service calls rather than a local supervised benchmark score.
The task is specified for a single A100 GPU and decapoda-research/llama-7b-hf assets, which are not available in the current CPU-oriented probe environment.
Earlier setup probe repaired the datasets dependency but failed because the Ubuntu host could not reach HuggingFace.
Earlier official and reduced probes reached train.py but timed out without producing checkpoints or scores.

claim_boundary: This probe does not add a third scored official MLAgentBench task. It adds a concrete inventory showing that BabyLM data preparation is accessible but scoring is blocked by HuggingFace model asset access, while several other official tasks are blocked by Kaggle consent, external LLM/service dependencies, GPU requirements, HuggingFace network, or CPU runtime.
recommended_next_step: Either cache the GPT-2 tokenizer/config assets locally and rerun the BabyLM compatibility path, or prioritize matched end-to-end co-pilot/autonomous trajectories instead of counting this as broad official benchmark coverage.
